ZONING ANALYSIS NARRATIVE FOR
10330 S. SPRINGFIELD AVENUE

The Subject Property requires a zoning change to allow for the side setbacks to be reduced for
the construction of a single-family residence. The Subject Property is unique because it is 42.73
feet wide by 300.52 feet deep. The Subject Property abuts the adjacent property to the west and
therefore is not served by an alley. The lot area is 12,860 sq.ft., which is well above the
minimum 5,000 sq. ft. set forth in 17-17-0302 of the Chicago Zoning Code. As mentioned
above, the Subject Property is not served by an alley and therefore, the single-family residence is
served by a two-car attached garage. The proposed home is 27 feet 7 4 inches in height. The
front setback is 20 feet which is the required set back. The rear set back requirement is 84.1 feet
and the actual set back will be over 222 feet. The side set back minimums are 6.4 feet and the
proposed set backs are 3 ft 1 7/8 inches on the north side and 3 feet 1 inch on the south side.
The reduction in side set backs is to allow for the attached garage, which is need to serve the
Subject Property because there is no alley.
